list.name: Public API Entry Points
list.description: Barrel modules exposing the package's two entry points: the main React-plus-core export and the React-free `/core` subpath.

list.name: React Bindings
list.description: SocketProvider context and hooks (global, local, event, send, state) that bind logical connections to React 18+ component lifecycles via external stores.

list.name: Core Connection Runtime
list.description: Framework-agnostic logical connection state machine, replaceable native WebSocket transport with heartbeat, and backoff utilities that drive reconnection.

list.name: Core Contracts
list.description: Typed connection definitions, options with validation and serialization, connection state models, and reconnection policy types shared by every other layer.

list.name: Test Suite
list.description: Vitest suites covering core reconnection behavior, React hooks, and compile-time protocol typing, backed by a MockWebSocket helper.

list.name: Build & Tooling Configuration
list.description: Package manifest, TypeScript project configs, Vite library/test build, ESLint rules, and npm publishing settings.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: README with overview, API reference and migration guide, plus the project license.

file:src/core/ConnectionDefinition.ts.name: ConnectionDefinition.ts
file:src/core/ConnectionDefinition.ts.summary: Declares the BaseMessage contract and the SocketDefinition identity/type token, plus defineSocket to create frozen, symbol-identified definitions that never open a socket.

file:src/core/ConnectionState.ts.name: ConnectionState.ts
file:src/core/ConnectionState.ts.summary: Defines connection status and error-code union types, the SocketError and ConnectionSnapshot shapes, and a snapshot factory for immutable state objects.

file:src/core/LogicalConnection.ts.name: LogicalConnection.ts
file:src/core/LogicalConnection.ts.summary: Core logical connection implementation: a stable identity that owns retry policy, outgoing queue, message/state subscriptions and open-waiters while swapping replaceable WebSocketTransport instances underneath. Also defines the SocketView/SocketController interfaces and the createSocket factory.

file:src/react/SocketProvider.tsx.name: SocketProvider.tsx
file:src/react/SocketProvider.tsx.summary: React context provider that eagerly creates a registry of LogicalConnections from socket registrations, connects them on mount, and disposes them on unmount in a Strict-Mode-safe way; also exposes registerSocket and useProviderSocket.

file:src/react/useGlobalSocket.ts.name: useGlobalSocket.ts
file:src/react/useGlobalSocket.ts.summary: Hook returning the read/send SocketView of a provider-registered global socket for a given definition.

file:src/react/useGlobalSocketController.name: useGlobalSocketController.ts
file:src/react/useGlobalSocketController.summary: Hook returning the full SocketController (connect/reconnect/update/close) for a provider-registered global socket.

file:src/react/useSocketEvent.ts.name: useSocketEvent.ts
file:src/react/useSocketEvent.ts.summary: Hook subscribing a handler to a typed message type (or wildcard) on a socket, keeping the latest handler in a ref to avoid resubscription.

file:src/react/useSocketSend.ts.name: useSocketSend.ts
file:src/react/useSocketSend.ts.summary: Hook producing a memoized send function bound to a socket.

file:src/react/useSocketState.ts.name: useSocketState.ts
file:src/react/useSocketState.ts.summary: Hook exposing a socket's ConnectionSnapshot to React via useSyncExternalStore.

file:src/core/index.ts.name: index.ts
file:src/core/index.ts.summary: React-free '/core' entry point barrel that re-exports socket definitions, the LogicalConnection/createSocket API, option and state types, and backoff helpers for standalone TypeScript use.

file:src/index.ts.name: index.ts
file:src/index.ts.summary: Main package entry point that re-exports the full public API: core connection primitives and types plus the React SocketProvider, registerSocket, and socket hooks.

file:tests/core.test.ts.name: core.test.ts
file:tests/core.test.ts.summary: Vitest suite for LogicalConnection behavior: identity preservation across transport replacement, update coalescing, reconnection/backoff, queue bounding and flushing, readiness waits, update validation with credential redaction, heartbeats, and codec rejection.

file:tests/helpers/MockWebSocket.ts.name: MockWebSocket.ts
file:tests/helpers/MockWebSocket.ts.summary: Test double for the browser WebSocket built on EventTarget, tracking created instances, sent payloads and close calls, with helpers to simulate open, message and abnormal close events.

file:tests/react.test.tsx.name: react.test.tsx
file:tests/react.test.tsx.summary: React integration tests verifying global sockets start without consumers and share one controller, local socket identity across re-renders and key changes, Strict Mode effect replay safety, and independent connections per hook owner.

file:tests/types.test.ts.name: types.test.ts
file:tests/types.test.ts.summary: Compile-time type tests using expectTypeOf and @ts-expect-error to ensure socket definitions bind incoming/outgoing message types, narrow subscribed events, and reject mismatched codecs or sends.

file:src/core/ConnectionOptions.ts.name: ConnectionOptions.ts
file:src/core/ConnectionOptions.ts.summary: Defines the typed socket configuration surface (SocketOptions, heartbeat/reconnect/queue options, MessageCodec, patch type) plus the default JSON codec and runtime validation/merging of options.

file:src/core/ReconnectionPolicy.ts.name: ReconnectionPolicy.ts
file:src/core/ReconnectionPolicy.ts.summary: Declares the BackoffStrategy type: a function mapping a one-based retry attempt to a delay in milliseconds.

file:src/core/WebSocketTransport.ts.name: WebSocketTransport.ts
file:src/core/WebSocketTransport.ts.summary: Wraps a single native WebSocket with an immutable handshake configuration, forwarding open/message/error/close events and managing heartbeat pings and silence timeouts; disposable so retired sockets never call back.

file:src/react/useLocalSocket.ts.name: useLocalSocket.ts
file:src/react/useLocalSocket.ts.summary: React hook that creates a component-scoped logical socket via createSocket, connecting on mount and closing/disposing on unmount with StrictMode-safe deferred disposal.

file:src/utils/Backoff.ts.name: Backoff.ts
file:src/utils/Backoff.ts.summary: Provides reconnection BackoffStrategy factories: exponential backoff with full jitter and a fixed-delay strategy.
